title: Transparent Surrogate Modeling of Psychedelic-Like Macro-Dynamics
description: Code and derived aggregate artifacts for a transparent macro-dynamics surrogate analysis of psychedelic neuroimaging. This archive is not a receptor-level, clinical, subjective-experience, or pharmacological simulator.
notes: Do not upload raw OpenNeuro imaging data through this repository archive.
